objective: Find which sections of HolyAgent's agent prompts are needed only at a specific moment and could move into skills that trigger then, without overdoing it.
scope: The instruction sources in packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/ (the root sections under root/, every specialist prompt, shared sections, session-reminder.md) and how the generated plugin assembles them (packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts and the dist/agents/*.md output). Existing skills: packages/runtime/src/instructions or packages/integrations/claude skills folders (dev-server, user-busy, setup).

For each candidate: the section and file, its size in words, the moment it is needed (the trigger a skill description would name), how often that moment comes up, and whether the agent's main job depends on it every turn (then it stays in the prompt).
constraints: Be conservative: propose a skill only for text that is needed at a specific moment rather than on most turns and is not the core reason the agent exists. Say for each rejected large section why it stays.

Keep working until the analysis is done, then stop and report under 600 words, with a ranked list of at most 8 candidates and the word count each would remove from the always-loaded prompt. Each evidence entry on one line as '<criterion label>: <support>'.

criteria.text: Candidates: each proposed skill names its source section, word count, trigger moment and which agents lose the text
Kept sections: the large sections that stay are named with the reason
